summary.intent: Complete Phase 45 (Desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup) through the full GSD workflow: plan, execute, verify, security review, Nyquist validation, PR creation, code review resolution, simplification, and coverage improvement.
summary.outcome: Phase 45 fully delivered — 6/6 plans executed (266 tests green), all GSD gates passed (verification 7/7, security 18/18 threats closed, Nyquist compliant), PR #491 pushed, all 4 CodeRabbit threads resolved, and patch coverage improved with an extracted pure classification helper.

repo: The Rust crate is `cipherbox-fuse` (feature `fuse`); Windows paths use `cipherbox-fuse/platform/windows` and can't compile on macOS due to `winfsp-sys`/`windows-*` deps — gated by Windows CI only.
`publish_file_metadata` (operations.rs:125) pre-existed before Phase 45 with identical conflict-swallowing behavior and was already called by the live release path — not introduced by this phase.
`generate_file_key()` returns a plain `[u8; 32]` with no zeroize-on-drop, meaning early `?` returns genuinely leaked raw key bytes before the fix.
`cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` is `pub use ecies::wrap_key` — exact re-export, safe to call interchangeably.

Running `rustfmt` (via `cargo fmt` or implicitly via executor) on one file in the `crates/fuse` package reformats all sibling files due to whole-workspace `rustfmt` traversal — caused stray working-tree drift twice during execution.
`gh pr edit` exits 1 on this repo because it queries deprecated Projects-classic; the workaround is `gh api -X PATCH /repos/.../pulls/N -F body=@file`.
The release bot (`github-actions[bot]`) may push `chore(release)` commits to a PR branch after PR creation, requiring `git fetch && git rebase` before subsequent local pushes.
GSD commit helper can return false-negative `commit_failed` even when lint-staged output is clean — always verify with `git log`.

Codecov tracks patch coverage per-PR; `lib.rs` had 34% patch coverage (444 missing lines) because most FUSE callbacks and replay paths require a live mount + network and cannot be unit-tested directly.

code.finding: New module consolidating fuser and winfsp journal builders; extracted three helpers — `current_unix_ms()`, `generate_entry_id()`, `wrap_key_to_hex()` — during /simplify pass to eliminate copy-paste between the two builders.

Zeroize fix for the file key: `build_upload_journal_entry` now calls `clear_bytes` on `file_key` before returning on both `encrypt_aes_gcm` and `ecies::wrap_key` error paths; without this, early `?` returns leaked raw key bytes since `generate_file_key()` returns a plain `[u8; 32]` with no Drop-based zeroize.

`next_file_publish_sequence` is a pure public fn added in this phase and was already unit-tested by the time Codecov ran (3 tests at lines 1877-1891); not a coverage gap despite the 34% patch coverage flag.

`resolve_ipns_for_replay` classification predicate (`contains("not found") || contains("404")`) was buried in an async network fn; extracted as `ipns_resolve_outcome_for_error` pure helper to enable unit testing and improve Codecov patch coverage.
Empty-locator `FilePointer` for legacy entries with empty `file_meta_ipns_name` — explicitly commented as preserving pre-Phase-45 behavior; CodeRabbit flagged as 'Heavy lift'; deferred as todo.

`publish_file_metadata` existed before Phase 45 with identical conflict-swallowing behavior — the deep code reviewer's CR-01 'blocker' was a false positive conflating this with the folder/bin publish retry-and-retain path.

workflow: When `cargo fmt` runs on any file in a Rust package it reformats all sibling files; scope formatting to a specific file with `rustfmt --edition 2021 <file.rs>` to prevent out-of-scope drift from polluting the PR diff.
IDE diagnostics (rust-analyzer) can reflect stale mid-edit state during subagent execution; always verify against `cargo check --workspace` ground truth before treating errors as real.
Deep code review blockers require manual verification against pre/post diff — both CR-01 and CR-02 in this session were false positives caused by the reviewer lacking full pre-refactor context.
GFM bare `#NN` in PR descriptions auto-links as issue/PR references; wrap in backticks (`` `#11` ``) for literal rendering when referencing internal tracking IDs without corresponding issues.

After discarding stray whole-crate fmt drift with `git checkout -- crates/`, always re-verify the committed tree (not the working tree) is green — tests run during the dirty state may not reflect what was committed.
The GSD `commit` helper false-negative pattern: if exit code shows failure but lint-staged output looks clean, verify via `git log` before taking corrective action.

For a no-behavior-change refactor, pre-existing behaviors that a phase explicitly preserved should be replied-to and resolved in PR review as 'out of scope / logged as todo' rather than implemented inline — implementing them would itself be a behavior change.

friction: Whole-crate `cargo fmt` drift occurred twice (once during 45-06 executor, once during coverage test work) — each time requiring manual identification, confirmation as fmt-only, and `git checkout --` revert before committing.
`gh pr edit` is broken on this repo due to deprecated Projects-classic GraphQL queries; required a workaround via `gh api -X PATCH` REST endpoint discovered mid-session.
Bare `#NN` in the initial PR description auto-linked to nonexistent issues — required a post-creation body patch.

Deep code review surfaced 2 false-positive 'blockers' (CR-01 conflict handling, CR-02 write_generation) that each required diving into pre-refactor git history to disprove, adding significant verification overhead.
Stale rust-analyzer IDE diagnostics (E0308 in lib.rs:632, 'not in module tree' for journal_helpers.rs) repeatedly showed errors that `cargo check` immediately disproved — created false alarm loops.
The GitHub push timed out on first attempt (transient network failure), requiring a retry.
GSD commit helper returned a false-negative `commit_failed` for a successful commit, requiring a `git log` verification step.
open_items: `resolve_ipns_for_replay` treats `PublishCoordinator::resolve_sequence` cache-fallback as `Found` — a transient non-404 failure returns `Found(cached)` instead of `IpnsResolveOutcome::Error`, causing replay to publish at `cached+1` instead of retaining the entry. Needs a strict resolve path. Todo: `.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-15-replay-resolve-ipns-strict-resolve-path-no-cache-fallback.md`

Empty `FilePointer` for legacy journal entries with empty `file_meta_ipns_name` — replay publishes an empty locator for these entries. CodeRabbit tagged 'Heavy lift'. Todo: `.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-15-replay-empty-file-meta-ipns-name-publishes-empty-filepointer.md`

Pre-existing code review warnings left as optional follow-ups (outside Phase 45 scope): atomicity of `update_status`, `Zeroizing` on plaintext fields, `deser_opt_string` applied to `file_ipns_key_hex`.
Replay key-unwrap helper extraction in `lib.rs` was deferred by /simplify — the sensitive crash-recovery path was not refactored to avoid churn risk.
The winfsp Windows path cannot be tested locally on macOS; it is CI-gated only. Recorded as manual-only in VALIDATION.md but no Windows CI confirmation exists yet for Phase 45 changes.
